title: Communication From Swiss Consul-General Re Mrs. Ruth Driskeli

page_data.en:
December 1st 34.

Confidential

Dear Mr. Jacot-Guillarmod,

With reference to your letter dated
November 7, 1934, I have caused inquiries to be
made regarding Mrs. Ruth Driskell and find that
she left on November 6 by the "Empress of Japan"
for Manila where her address is c/o Manila Hotel.
It is said that Miss Naylor of the Land Office
of the American Consulate attends to business
matters on behalf of Mrs. Driskell.

Yours sincerely,

〔签名〕

L. Ch. Jacot-Guillarmod, Esq.,
Swiss Consulate-General,
Shanghai.

D.C. (br.)
Information. Kent
has also left Shanghai.
〔签名〕
DEC 3 1934

File
〔签名〕
DEC 3 1934

（印：DEPUTY COMMISSIONER DEC 3 1934 (CRIME BRANCH)）
page_data.zh:
1934年12月1日。

机密

亲爱的雅科-吉亚尔莫先生：

关于您1934年11月7日的来信，我已就鲁思·德里斯克尔夫人（Mrs. Ruth Driskell）一事进行查询，查得她已于11月6日乘“日本皇后号”（Empress of Japan）轮前往马尼拉，其在马尼拉的地址为转交马尼拉酒店（Manila Hotel）。据悉，美国领事馆地政处的内勒小姐（Miss Naylor）正代表德里斯克尔夫人处理商务事宜。

此致

敬礼

〔签名〕

L. Ch. 雅科-吉亚尔莫 先生，
瑞士总领事馆，
上海。

D.C. (br.)
情报。肯特（Kent）也已离开上海。
〔签名〕
1934年12月3日

归档
〔签名〕
1934年12月3日

（印：副警务处长 1934年12月3日（刑事部））

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No: S.R+GL:TRY.
Section 2, Special Branch. **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date November 30, 19 34

Subject (in full) Communication from Swiss Consul-General re.
Mrs. Ruth Driskell.

Made by D.S. Poole Forwarded by **〔此处转录不清〕**

At about 6.30 a.m. on the 23rd September 1934 a telephone
message was received by Hongkew Station that a foreign female
had been admitted to the General Hospital suffering from
injuries received in an accident in the French Concession.

On enquiries being made it was ascertained that the patient's
name was Mrs. Ruth Diskell, American, **〔此处转录不清〕**, who was residing
at 153 Route de Soeurs, French Concession. At this time she
was bleeding profusely from a wound in the head.

Further enquiries showed that about 5.45 a.m. on the 23.9.34
Mr. V. Ackerman, residing at 150 Rue de Roi Albert, French
Concession, was walking along Rue Bourgeat near Route Vallon
when he saw the injured woman wandering about the street
bleeding from a head-wound. He placed her in a ricsha with
the intention of taking her to a police station, but on Avenue
Joffre saw the French Municipal Ambulance and called upon it
to take the woman to the General Hospital. The patient
demanded that she be attended by her own doctor Dr. R.J.B. Branch
of 8 Route Adina, French Concession, who immediately attended
the hospital. After his preliminary examination he stated that
he suspected that the patient had been shot in the head. There
was a small puncture on the right side of the skull but no mark
of exit of the bullet if such were the injury. The woman at
this time stated that she believed she had been shot.

At about 11 a.m. on September 23rd 1934 Mr. E.L. Faupel,
U.S. Marshal, and Chief Inspector Valentain of the French Police
came to Central Station and requested assistance to interview
a Mr. R. Kent, British subject residing at No.114 Verdun
Terrace, French Concession, regarding Mrs. Driskell.

They stated that Mrs. Driskell was last seen at about

S.R.

Is Kents occupation known?
JHS

日期 1934年11月30日

主题（全称） 瑞士总领事关于鲁思·德里斯克尔夫人的来函。

呈报人 D.S. 普尔 转呈人 **〔此处转录不清〕**

1934年9月23日上午约6时30分，虹口捕房接到电话消息，称有一名外籍女子因在法租界发生的事故中受伤而被送入广慈医院（General Hospital）。

经查询得知，该病人名叫鲁思·迪斯科尔夫人（Mrs. Ruth Diskell），美国人，**〔此处转录不清〕**，居住于法租界修女路（Route de Soeurs）153号。当时她头部伤口大量出血。

进一步查询显示，1934年9月23日上午约5时45分，居住于法租界阿尔伯特国王路（Rue de Roi Albert）150号的V. 阿克曼先生（Mr. V. Ackerman）在瓦隆路（Route Vallon）附近的布尔热阿路（Rue Bourgeat）行走时，看见这名受伤女子在街头徘徊，头部伤口流血。他将她扶上一辆人力车，打算带她去警察局，但在霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）看到法公董局救护车，便叫住该车将女子送往广慈医院。病人要求由其私人医生诊治，该医生为法租界阿迪纳路（Route Adina）8号的R.J.B. 布兰奇医生（Dr. R.J.B. Branch），他随即赶到医院。经过初步检查后，他表示怀疑病人头部中枪。头骨右侧有一个小穿刺孔，但如果确系此类伤害，则未见子弹出口痕迹。该女子当时表示，她相信自己是被枪击的。

1934年9月23日上午约11时，美国法警E.L. 福佩尔先生（Mr. E.L. Faupel）和法国警察总监瓦伦坦督察长（Chief Inspector Valentain）来到中央捕房，请求协助讯问一名英国籍男子R. 肯特先生（Mr. R. Kent），他居住于法租界凡尔登台（Verdun Terrace）114号，以了解有关德里斯克尔夫人的情况。

他们称，德里斯克尔夫人最后被见到是在大约

10 p.m. 22.9;34 in company with Mr. Kent in her apartment
at 153 Route des Soeurs and they thought that he might be
able to enlighten them as to the way she came by her injuries.
        As Mr. Kent is a British subject it was thought that
permission to interview him might be had from a British
Consular Official but all attempts to get in touch with any of
them failed.
        The D.D.O."A" was then communicated with who instructed
that the party was to be accompanied to French Concession by
a foreign detective to watch the enquiries. On arrival it
was found that Mr. Kent had already made the following statement:-
        "At 8 p.m. September 22 in company with four others I
attended a dinner party at Mrs. Driskell's apartment. After
dinner, at about 10 p.m. I went home and changed and returned
to rejoin the party. Then together with Mrs. Driskell we all
went to the Canidrome Ballroom, where we stayed till about
12.30 a.m. September 23. We then went together to the Delmonte
Cafe where Mrs. Driskell and I had an argument which resulted
in Mrs. Driskell leaving the place alone at about 3.30a.m. and
she went away in a hired motorcar. At about 4 a.m. I left
the Delmonte with a lady friend; one of our party, accompanying
her to her home where I stayed with her till 10a.m. Sept. 23."
        At about 1 p.m. 23.9.34 Mr. Faupel visited Mrs. Driskell
in the hospital and found her conscious. She informed him
that when she entered a hire car at the Delmonte Cabaret she
lost consciousness and could not recollect anything that
happened after.
        Inquiries by the French Police failed to locate the hire
car, the number of which is unknown, neither could the ricsha

1934年9月22日晚上10点，与其公寓位于修女路（Route des Soeurs）153号的肯特先生在一起，他们认为他或许能说明她受伤的原因。
        由于肯特先生是英国臣民，原以为可以从英国领事官员处获得讯问他的许可，但试图联系任何一位英国领事官员的努力均告失败。
        随后联系了“A”区副巡官（D.D.O."A"），他指示由一名外籍侦探陪同前往法租界监视此次查询。到达后发现，肯特先生已作出如下陈述：
        “9月22日晚8点，我与其他四人一起参加了在德里斯克尔夫人公寓举行的晚宴。晚餐后，约晚上10点，我回家更衣并返回重新加入聚会。随后，我们与德里斯克尔夫人一同前往卡尼德罗姆舞厅（Canidrome Ballroom），在那里待到1934年9月23日凌晨约12点30分。之后我们一同前往德尔蒙特咖啡馆（Delmonte Cafe），在那里我与德里斯克尔夫人发生争执，导致德里斯克尔夫人于凌晨约3点30分独自离开该处，她乘坐一辆租赁汽车离去。凌晨约4点，我与一位女性朋友——也是我们聚会中的一员——离开德尔蒙特咖啡馆，送她回家，并在那里陪她直到9月23日上午10点。”
        1934年9月23日下午约1点，福佩尔先生去医院探望德里斯克尔夫人，发现她意识清醒。她告知福佩尔先生，当她在德尔蒙特歌舞厅（Delmonte Cabaret）进入一辆租赁汽车时，她失去了知觉，此后发生的事情一概不记得。

法国警察局的调查未能找到那辆租赁汽车，其车牌号码不详，也未能找到那辆人力车

On the 25.9.34 Mrs. Driskell returned home from the Hospital and gave a statement to the U.S. Marshal and the French Police.

She stated that after attending a party at the Delmonte Cafe she returned to her residence in a hire car. Here she discovered that she had neglected to take her front door key which was then with Mr. Kent. As she had dismissed the car she engaged a ricsha to convey her back to the Delmonte. Whilst proceeding along Rue Bourgeat the ricsha coolie slipped and overturned the ricsha. Her head struck a sharp stone which caused the head injury. She then intended to go to her nearest friend's house which happened to be Mr. Kent's, to get first aid. However she lost consciousness and never reached her destination.

The French Police have classified this affair as an accident.

On November 6th 1934 Mrs. Driskell left Shanghai on the "Empress of Japan" for Manila. Her address there is c/o the "Manila Hotel". She has no intention of returning to Shanghai. A Miss Naylor of the Land Office of the American Consulate is acting as her representative in Shanghai for any transactions which she may have forgotten.

（批：Reg. I）
（批：Please ascertain if there is a file about the inquiries made in September. M.B.）
（签名：D. S.）

NOV. 8 1934    I
Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch.)    （批：Sir Central Stn Misc 480/34 attached. W.G.）

1934年9月25日，德里斯克尔夫人从医院回到家中，并向美国法警和法国警察局作了陈述。

她称，在参加完德尔蒙特咖啡馆的聚会后，她乘坐一辆租赁汽车返回住所。在这里她发现自己忘了带前门钥匙，而钥匙当时在肯特先生那里。由于她已经打发了汽车，便雇了一辆人力车送她回德尔蒙特咖啡馆。在沿布尔热阿路（Rue Bourgeat）行进时，人力车夫滑倒，导致人力车翻覆。她的头部撞到一块尖石上，造成了头部受伤。随后她打算去离她最近的朋友家寻求急救，碰巧那是肯特先生的家。然而她失去了知觉，从未到达目的地。

法国警察局已将此事归类为意外事故。

1934年11月6日，德里斯克尔夫人乘“日本皇后号”轮离开上海前往马尼拉。她在马尼拉的地址为转交“马尼拉酒店”。她无意返回上海。美国领事馆地政处的一位内勒小姐（Miss Naylor）正在上海担任她的代理人，处理她可能遗忘的任何事务。

CONSULAT GÉNÉRAL DE SUISSE

SHANGHAI November 27th 1934.
TELEG. ADR. SWISSCOLAT
A. B. C. 5ÈME & 6ÈME ED.
BENTLEY'S COMPLETE & SECOND PHRASE CODE

REFERENCE NOTRE J.- VI 235/ 2382
VOTRE

Mr. T.P. Givens,
Deputy Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Dear Mr. Givens,

I am trying to find here in Shanghai
Mrs. Ruth Driskell.

She used to live at 267 Kiangse Road, 400
Avenue Haig, 153 Route des Soeurs. Then after an
accident she was conveyed on the 23rd of September 1934
to the General Hospital.

Do you have any records on her ?

I remain,
dear Mr. Givens,
Yours faithfully,

〔签名〕
Consul General.

亲爱的吉文斯先生：

我正试图在上海寻找
鲁思·德里斯克尔夫人。

她曾居住在江西路（Kiangse Road）267号、海格路（Avenue Haig）400号、修女路（Route des Soeurs）153号。随后在一次事故后，她于1934年9月23日被送往广慈医院。
